description: This file defines the GLFace class, which models a polygonal face (triangle or quadrilateral) using vertices and colors, including methods to add vertices, set color, generate indices, and output vertex indices for rendering.

classes.name: GLFace
classes.description: Represents a 3D polygonal face (triangle or quadrilateral) with vertex management, color setting, and index buffer generation.

methods.name: GLFace
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the face with three vertices (triangle).

methods.name: GLFace
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the face with four vertices (quadrilateral).

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to the face's vertex list.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the face and adjusts vertices accordingly.

methods.name: getIndexCount
methods.description: Returns the number of indices needed to draw the face.

methods.name: putIndices
methods.description: Fills a buffer with vertex indices for rendering the face.
